review_method: Independent visual inspection of the retained WSA and Elections original-plus-registered-overlay pixels for only the three assigned targets, the original PDFs and successful acquisition receipts. Full source and baseline-rendered polygon plots were inspected. All ordered positions, part/ring counts and closure were independently compared using the retained original source collection and selected decoded baseline. Every position fits within its inspected source-map crop. Complete outline, orientation, nearby distinct waters and material omitted portions were considered together; neither a bounding box nor label overlap alone established identity. First observations were recorded before reading the source researcher draft. The production decoder was not independently replayed by this reviewer.
counted_unit: Distinct logical inventory lake target IDs; repeated map labels do not increase the target count.

findings.follow_up_scope: Before assigning one whole-feature scalar name, resolve the distinct Hatchet and Phillips water-name extents against the selected generalized ring using appropriately authorized detailed evidence. This is a name-scope hold, not an access failure.
findings.supported_name_scope: The main basin supports Hatchet Lake and the northern/northwestern included area supports a Phillips Lake association. These are distinct component associations, not aliases or a single whole-feature identity. A separately labelled Phillips Lake area is implicated at the generalized northern/northwestern margin. Exact Hatchet-Phillips-Corson divisions, detailed shore/island coverage and complete named-lake extents are not established. Exact extent and product-name application are not approved.
limits: A separately labelled Phillips Lake area is implicated at the generalized northern/northwestern margin. Exact Hatchet-Phillips-Corson divisions, detailed shore/island coverage and complete named-lake extents are not established.
Corson Lake and LeDrew Lake are distinct nearby waters; no precise geometric partition of the Phillips-labelled area is asserted.
Retained official thematic/electoral maps from two publisher groups support these observations. Independence of underlying hydrographic datasets and formal naming-registry authority are unverified.
No Korean form or additional alias is certified; coarse cartographic registration does not establish exact shorelines or name boundaries.
